CustomField.description: The Tax Identification Number (SSN, EIN, or ITIN) for this investing entity, used for tax reporting (K-1 issuance) and AML/KYC compliance. Stored as Text (Encrypted, Classic Encryption) - masked to the last four characters for users without the View Encrypted Data permission.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the entity's SSN, EIN, or ITIN. Only the last four characters are shown unless you have View Encrypted Data access.
CustomField.label: Tax ID
